scenarios.title: Inbox Overload
scenarios.scenario: The executive you support has been out of the office for a week attending a conference and returning client calls. When they return, they find hundreds of unread emails waiting in their inbox and feel overwhelmed by where to begin. Several important projects are currently active, and they are worried about missing something important. They ask for help getting caught up and focusing on the items that deserve immediate attention.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Outlook Copilot works directly with inbox content and can summarize messages, identify action items, and help prioritize what deserves attention first.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Review my unread emails from the last seven days, identify urgent messages and action items, and create a prioritized summary for my executive using bullet points.

scenarios.title: Policy Draft
scenarios.scenario: An HR manager recently met with leadership to discuss changes to the organization's remote work approach. The team has pages of notes, ideas, and concerns but no formal document. Employees are waiting for guidance, and leadership wants something professional they can review quickly. The HR manager needs help turning scattered information into a polished policy.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Word Copilot is built for creating and refining structured business documents such as policies, procedures, and employee communications.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a remote work policy using these leadership meeting notes. Organize it into clear sections for employees and use a professional tone.

scenarios.title: Leadership Deck Needed Tomorrow
scenarios.scenario: A project manager has spent the last month collecting updates from team members, stakeholders, and vendors. Unfortunately, the information is spread across emails, documents, chat messages, and meeting notes. Leadership expects a concise project update presentation tomorrow morning, and there is not enough time to build everything from scratch. The project manager needs a faster way to assemble the story.
scenarios.toolExplanation: PowerPoint Copilot can transform source content into slides, speaker notes, and presentation-ready storylines.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create an executive presentation using these project updates and meeting notes. Highlight key accomplishments, risks, and next steps in a concise format.

scenarios.title: Sales Data Mystery
scenarios.scenario: A sales manager has access to six months of sales data but has struggled to understand what the numbers are telling them. Performance feels inconsistent from month to month, and leadership has started asking questions about recent results. They need to identify trends, successes, and potential concerns before the next leadership meeting. The challenge is finding meaningful insights quickly.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Excel Copilot is optimized for trend analysis, data exploration, calculations, and identifying patterns within spreadsheets.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Analyze the last six months of sales data, identify trends and outliers, and summarize the most important findings for leadership.

scenarios.title: Missed Meeting
scenarios.scenario: You were unable to attend an important project meeting due to a scheduling conflict. The discussion included key stakeholders, project decisions, and next steps that may impact your work. You have another meeting starting in fifteen minutes and need to understand what happened before joining the conversation. Reviewing the entire recording is not realistic given your limited time.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Teams Copilot can summarize meetings, identify decisions, surface action items, and help users quickly catch up.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Summarize this meeting, identify decisions and action items, and provide the information I need before meeting with stakeholders.

scenarios.title: New Competitor Appears
scenarios.scenario: Leadership recently learned about a new competitor entering the market. Very little is known about the company, but there is concern about how it could affect future business opportunities. A discussion has been scheduled for tomorrow, and leadership wants a better understanding of the potential risks and opportunities. Someone needs to gather and summarize the available information.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Copilot Chat excels at researching topics, summarizing information, comparing sources, and preparing discussion materials.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Research this competitor and provide a leadership briefing that summarizes strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and risks.

scenarios.title: Client Proposal Creation
scenarios.scenario: A consultant recently completed a discovery session with a prospective client. The client shared challenges, goals, and requirements, but the information currently exists only in meeting notes and rough observations. The consultant needs to develop a proposal that communicates value and outlines a recommended approach. Time is limited, and the first draft needs to be completed quickly.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Word Copilot is designed to turn rough ideas, meeting notes, and source material into professional business documents. Since the desired outcome is a formal proposal, Word Copilot provides the most direct path to a polished deliverable.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a professional client proposal using these discovery notes. Organize the proposal into sections for business challenges, recommended solution, timeline, and expected outcomes.

scenarios.title: Customer Meeting Preparation
scenarios.toolExplanation: Copilot Chat can gather and synthesize information from multiple Microsoft 365 sources, making it ideal for preparing a comprehensive client briefing before a meeting.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Review recent client communications, identify outstanding requests and key discussion topics, and create a concise briefing that will help me prepare for today's meeting.

scenarios.title: Department Newsletter
scenarios.scenario: Several teams across your department recently submitted updates they would like shared with employees. The information covers accomplishments, upcoming initiatives, staffing changes, and important announcements. Leadership wants the communication to feel organized, professional, and easy to read. Someone now needs to transform the collection of updates into a polished newsletter.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Word Copilot is best suited for creating well-structured written communications such as newsletters, announcements, and employee updates.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a department newsletter using these team updates. Organize the content into clear sections, write for employees, and highlight the most important announcements.

scenarios.title: Expense Review
scenarios.scenario: A department director has noticed that budget conversations are becoming more difficult because spending appears higher than expected. While financial reports are available, it's not immediately clear where increases are occurring or whether there is cause for concern. Leadership is looking for answers before the next budgeting discussion. The director needs help identifying what deserves a closer look.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Excel Copilot is designed to analyze financial data, identify trends and outliers, and explain findings within spreadsheet data.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Analyze this expense data, identify unusual spending patterns and cost increases, and provide a summary highlighting the areas that deserve management attention.

scenarios.title: Quarterly Business Review
scenarios.scenario: Leadership has requested a quarterly business review that summarizes the organization's performance across multiple areas. Financial results, project updates, operational metrics, and risk reports all exist in separate files maintained by different teams. The executive team wants a concise and professional presentation that highlights the most important information. The challenge is turning a large volume of content into a clear story that supports decision-making.
scenarios.toolExplanation: PowerPoint Copilot is best suited when the desired outcome is an executive presentation that combines information from multiple sources into a structured narrative.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a 10-slide executive business review using these reports. Summarize financial performance, project status, operational metrics, risks, and recommended actions.

scenarios.title: Employee Survey Analysis
scenarios.scenario: An HR team recently completed an employee engagement survey and received hundreds of responses from employees across the organization. Leadership wants to understand what employees are saying, which concerns appear most frequently, and where improvements should be prioritized. While the feedback is valuable, manually reviewing every response would take significant time. The HR team needs help identifying meaningful patterns and trends.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Excel Copilot can analyze large datasets, identify trends, summarize responses, and quantify patterns across survey results.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Analyze these survey results, identify common themes and concerns, summarize positive feedback, and provide a report for HR leadership.

scenarios.title: Grant Application
scenarios.scenario: A nonprofit organization has identified a funding opportunity that aligns with its mission and programs. The team has organizational information, program descriptions, and impact metrics available, but it has not yet been assembled into a compelling application. Leadership wants to submit a strong proposal before the deadline. The challenge is organizing the information into a persuasive narrative that addresses the funder's requirements.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Word Copilot is ideal for drafting structured, persuasive written content such as grant applications and proposals.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a grant application using this organizational information. Align the response to the funding requirements and emphasize community impact.

scenarios.title: Contract Review
scenarios.scenario: A legal team has received a lengthy contract from a vendor and needs to quickly understand its implications. The agreement contains dozens of pages of terms, conditions, obligations, and legal language that will require review. Several stakeholders are waiting for a recommendation on how to proceed. The legal team needs an efficient way to identify risks, key provisions, and potential concerns before deeper analysis begins.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Copilot Chat excels at reviewing large amounts of content and summarizing key findings, obligations, and risks.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Review this contract and summarize key obligations, risks, deadlines, and clauses that require further legal review.

scenarios.title: Healthcare Operations Update
scenarios.scenario: A healthcare leader is preparing for a meeting with hospital leadership and must explain recent operational performance. Patient satisfaction scores, service metrics, and departmental performance data have all changed over the last quarter. Leadership wants to understand where progress has been made and where additional attention may be needed. The challenge is communicating complex information in a clear and concise manner.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Word Copilot helps transform data and findings into a structured business report written for leadership audiences.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a leadership report summarizing patient satisfaction trends, operational performance metrics, and recommended areas for improvement.

scenarios.title: School Board Presentation
scenarios.scenario: A school administrator is preparing materials for an upcoming school board meeting. Board members expect an overview of student performance, budget information, strategic initiatives, and district priorities. The information exists across multiple reports and spreadsheets developed by different departments. The administrator needs a way to assemble a presentation that communicates the most important information effectively.
scenarios.toolExplanation: PowerPoint Copilot is the strongest choice when the outcome is a presentation intended for leadership and decision makers.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a presentation for the school board that summarizes student performance, budget status, district priorities, and recommended next steps.

scenarios.title: Government Procurement Analysis
scenarios.scenario: A government department is reviewing procurement spending and wants to better understand where funding is being used. Purchasing activity has increased over time, and leadership is looking for opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs. The available data contains thousands of transactions across numerous categories and vendors. Decision-makers need help identifying patterns and areas that deserve additional review.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Excel Copilot is best for analyzing spending data, identifying procurement trends, and surfacing cost-saving opportunities.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Analyze procurement spending data, identify major spending categories and cost-saving opportunities, and summarize your findings.

scenarios.title: Knowledge Search Across Multiple Sources
scenarios.scenario: An employee has been asked to answer a business question but is unsure where the necessary information exists. Relevant details could be buried in emails, meeting recordings, chat conversations, documents, or presentations created by different teams. Manually searching every source would take hours and may still miss important details. The employee needs a faster way to locate information and assemble a complete answer.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Copilot Chat can search across Microsoft 365 content and synthesize information from multiple sources into a single response.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Search across my Microsoft 365 content and summarize information related to this topic, including supporting documents, emails, meetings, and chats.

scenarios.title: Project Risk Assessment
scenarios.scenario: A project manager is beginning to hear concerns about potential delays and missed deadlines. Project documentation, status reports, meeting notes, and stakeholder communications contain valuable information, but reviewing everything manually would require significant effort. Leadership is asking for an assessment of the project's health and the most significant risks. The project manager needs a way to identify issues before they become major problems.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Copilot Chat can analyze project content from multiple sources and identify potential risks, blockers, and concerns.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Review project documentation and status updates, identify the most significant risks or delays, and recommend actions to reduce project impact.

scenarios.title: Customer Feedback Review
scenarios.scenario: Over the past several months, hundreds of customer comments have been collected through surveys, support cases, and feedback forms. Leadership believes there are valuable insights hidden within the responses but lacks a clear understanding of what customers care about most. Reviewing each comment individually would be time-consuming and difficult to scale. The organization needs a way to identify themes, concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Copilot Chat can synthesize large amounts of unstructured feedback and identify meaningful themes, concerns, and opportunities.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Analyze these customer comments, identify common themes and concerns, prioritize the most important issues, and summarize opportunities for improvement.

scenarios.title: HR Question Overload
scenarios.scenario: The HR team receives a constant stream of questions about PTO, benefits, holidays, workplace policies, and employee programs. Many of these questions are asked repeatedly, even though the answers already exist in company documentation. HR staff spend a considerable amount of time responding to routine requests rather than focusing on strategic initiatives. Leadership is looking for a better way to help employees find answers on their own.
scenarios.toolExplanation: An Agent is designed to provide consistent answers based on approved knowledge sources and can reduce repetitive work by enabling employee self-service.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create an HR knowledge agent that answers common employee questions about PTO, benefits, holidays, and company policies using approved HR documentation.

scenarios.title: IT Help Desk Assistant
scenarios.scenario: The IT team is overwhelmed by requests ranging from password resets to software installation questions and basic troubleshooting. While many issues have already been documented, employees often struggle to locate the information they need. Support staff spend a large portion of their time answering the same questions repeatedly. Leadership wants a solution that improves response times while reducing pressure on the help desk team.
scenarios.toolExplanation: An Agent can provide immediate answers to common support requests while freeing IT staff to focus on more complex issues.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create an IT support agent that answers common troubleshooting and password questions using approved support documentation.

scenarios.title: New Hire Support
scenarios.scenario: Every month, new employees join the organization with questions about systems, policies, benefits, training, and onboarding tasks. The information exists, but it is scattered across documents, intranet pages, emails, and training materials. Managers and HR staff spend significant time answering the same questions for every new employee. The organization wants to provide a more consistent onboarding experience while reducing interruptions.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Agents are ideal for onboarding because they provide a centralized knowledge experience that scales to every new employee.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create an onboarding agent that helps new employees find answers about benefits, company policies, technology setup, and onboarding activities.

scenarios.title: Manufacturing Procedures
scenarios.scenario: Employees on the production floor frequently need access to standard operating procedures, safety requirements, and process documentation. The information is available but often requires searching through manuals or contacting experienced team members for assistance. Delays in finding answers can impact productivity and introduce compliance risks. Management wants a faster and more reliable way to provide guidance during daily operations.
scenarios.toolExplanation: An Agent can deliver fast answers from approved SOPs and safety documentation, helping employees access critical information when needed.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a manufacturing knowledge agent that helps employees find standard operating procedures and safety guidance from approved documentation.

scenarios.title: Compliance Knowledge Assistant
scenarios.scenario: Employees regularly need answers about compliance requirements, policies, and regulatory obligations. The information exists in various manuals, procedures, and policy documents, but locating the right guidance can be difficult. Leadership wants to reduce the risk of inconsistent answers while ensuring employees have access to approved information. The challenge is making trusted compliance knowledge easy to find and use.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Compliance information benefits from a governed experience where users receive answers from approved and trusted sources.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a compliance agent that answers employee questions using approved compliance policies, procedures, and regulatory guidance.

scenarios.title: Vendor Agreement Search
scenarios.scenario: Procurement staff frequently need information from vendor contracts, including renewal dates, pricing terms, service levels, and contractual obligations. Unfortunately, those agreements are spread across numerous documents and repositories. Finding answers often requires manually reviewing lengthy contracts. The procurement team wants a faster way to locate information and support business decisions.
scenarios.toolExplanation: An Agent can search a managed contract repository and answer questions without requiring users to manually review agreements.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a procurement agent that helps staff quickly find answers from vendor contracts and related procurement documentation.

scenarios.title: Customer Service Knowledge Base
scenarios.scenario: Customer service representatives handle a large volume of inquiries every day and often need to reference approved responses, procedures, and support documentation. Even when the information exists, locating it quickly can be difficult, which increases response time and creates inconsistency. Leadership wants customers to receive accurate answers regardless of which representative handles the case. The team needs a better way to surface trusted information during interactions.
scenarios.toolExplanation: An Agent can provide approved responses and procedural guidance to support consistent customer interactions.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create a customer service knowledge agent that provides approved responses and support guidance using official documentation.

scenarios.title: Executive Research Briefing
scenarios.scenario: Leadership is evaluating a strategic issue and needs recommendations before making an important decision. Relevant information exists across reports, presentations, research documents, and previous analyses developed by multiple teams. Executives do not have time to review every source individually but still need confidence in the conclusions. Someone must synthesize the available information and identify key recommendations.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Copilot Chat excels at synthesizing information from multiple sources and producing recommendations based on diverse content.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Review these reports and documents, identify strategic risks and opportunities, and prepare an executive briefing with recommendations.

scenarios.title: Merger Planning
scenarios.scenario: An executive team is preparing for a potential merger between two organizations. Documentation from both companies includes operational processes, organizational structures, policies, technology platforms, and strategic plans. Leadership wants to understand where potential integration challenges may exist before moving forward. The challenge is reviewing a large volume of information and identifying areas of risk and opportunity.
scenarios.toolExplanation: Copilot Chat is ideal for comparing information from multiple sources and surfacing risks, gaps, and opportunities.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Compare information from these organizations and identify potential integration challenges, risks, and recommendations for leadership.

scenarios.title: Enterprise Knowledge Hub
scenarios.scenario: Employees across HR, Finance, IT, Operations, and other departments regularly struggle to find answers to common questions. Information exists throughout the organization, but it is spread across multiple repositories, sites, and systems that are not always easy to navigate. Teams frequently contact subject matter experts to locate information that already exists somewhere else. Leadership wants a more centralized and self-service approach to knowledge discovery.
scenarios.toolExplanation: An Agent creates a centralized experience that makes organizational knowledge easier to discover across multiple departments.
scenarios.samplePrompt: Create an enterprise knowledge agent that helps employees find information across HR, Finance, IT, and Operations using approved content sources.
